title: Privacy policy
intro: BizCode processes customer personal data in the operator environment (desktop or SaaS). This page summarizes the product data inventory; it does not replace AAIP registration or the operator’s legal advice.
inventoryBody: Customer legal name, tax ID, address, phone and email; delivery proof (POD) and driver GPS samples when the related modules are enabled.
rightsAccess: Access: owner or super_admin can export the customer data package from the customer form.
rightsRectification: Rectification: update the customer form with customers.manage.
rightsErasure: Erasure: irreversible PII anonymization on the master record (fiscal documents are kept).
rightsOpposition: Objection to marketing uses: BizCode has no marketing engine; operators must not use this data for campaigns without their own legal basis.
retentionBody: Fiscal documents: 10 years. Optional commercial data (email/phone): until deletion request or anonymization. GPS: 7 days.
aaipBody: Database registration with Argentina’s AAIP is the operator’s responsibility. BizCode documents the procedure and does not invent a registration number.
contactBody: Contact your BizCode instance operator. In the app, owner/super_admin use Export data and Anonymize on the customer form.
